name: RGB Cube AVIP
definition: A variant of AVIP0 that maps the spatial coordinates of the current voxel directly to the RGB color channels during the accumulation process, providing a qualitative visualization of spatial and spectral coordinates.
summary: RGB Cube AVIP is a direct volume ray casting technique that maps 3D spatial coordinates to RGB color channels, allowing viewers to perceive volume structure through color alone without scalar-to-color mapping.
